previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: A 58-year-old woman with a complex history of fibrosing mesenteritis, recurrent small bowel obstructions, and G-tube dependence was readmitted one week after discharge due to recurrent fevers and positive blood cultures for coagulase-negative staphylococcus. The infection was traced to her port-a-cath and PICC line, both of which were removed. She completed a four-week course of IV vancomycin, with follow-up cultures remaining negative. During the admission, she developed new-onset severe abdominal pain, prompting multiple imaging studies and an enteroscopy, which showed partial mechanical obstruction from adhesions but no surgical cause. Her pain was managed with a multimodal regimen including gabapentin, morphine, and amitriptyline. She also experienced transient acute kidney injury due to dehydration from high G-tube output, which resolved with IV fluids. Her G-tube was replaced due to leakage. She was discharged home on TPN, bolus IV fluids, full liquids, and a revised medication regimen, with plans for follow-up blood cultures and potential port reinsertion.

Brief Hospital Course:
Acute on chronic abd pain: She has a complex past medical 
history of recurrent abdominal pain and presented with RUQ pain 
that she felt was different than baseline abdominal pain.  Her 
transaminases were normal and renal ultrasound did not show 
acute pathology.  Urinanalysis was negative and there was no 
fever or leukocytosis to suggest acute infection.  She was 
treated with Toradol, IV morphine and warm packs with 
improvement in her pain, which was thought to be 
musculoskeletal.  SW was involved and helped provide supportive 
care.  She was otherwise continued on her recent discharge 
regimen for chronic abdominal pain including Zofran, Phenergan, 
Miralax, Colace, Morphine Oral concentrate and intermittent 
venting via gtube.  She was continued on liquids and TPN for 
nutritional support.

Mesenteric Fibromytosis: continued on home regimen of Octreotide 
100mcg TID

Sjogrens: continued on home pilocarpine NF, artificial tears & 
misoprostol

h/o Upper extremity DVT: continued on Lovenox 80mg BID

Depression: SW was consulted on admission and provided 
supportive care throughout admission.  Pt was continued on home 
regimen of Lamictal, Trazodone, Amitriptyline and Ativan.
